Every wording of the state-prose corpus (corpusPools) that needs a house of the place that is not of a hideable kind, one row per (pool, vid, house atom), sorted. Listed, never red; the security reader tests this list at the join against the veil's own registry. tests/lint/samenessHideable.walker.test.js holds it equal to the reading. PHASE 3 (SAME-2 brief H unit 1): "hand" lists the hand-listed pools' declared lines' houses (pool, the line's text hash, house), sorted.

src/data/historyData.js :: HISTORY_DESC_SIBLINGS::A period of ambitious stone construction transformed the settlement's character. Walls, civic buildings, or a cathedral raised from local quarry stone. The quarry workers became a political force.
src/data/historyData.js :: HISTORY_DESC_SIBLINGS::A rival family claims their ancestor was cheated out of the original mining contract

src/data/historyData.js :: HISTORY_DESC_SIBLINGS::After years of disputed grain prices, the major farming families and the guilds negotiated a formal compact regulating grain sale and storage. It held for a generation.
src/data/historyData.js :: HISTORY_DESC_SIBLINGS::Fortified extraction sites established during the dispute
src/data/historyData.js :: HISTORY_DESC_SIBLINGS::Price ceilings on the affected goods still enforced in lean seasons
src/data/historyData.js :: HISTORY_DESC_SIBLINGS::Quarrymen's guild retains unusual civic influence

src/data/historyData.js :: HISTORY_DESC_SIBLINGS::Rights to the local iron deposits became the subject of a prolonged dispute between the settlement and a rival lord. The outcome shaped who controls extraction to this day.
src/data/historyData.js :: HISTORY_DESC_SIBLINGS::Watch towers and muster drills maintained since the alarm

src/data/institutionDescVariants.js :: DESC_VARIANT_SIBLINGS::A corner of the holding left out of the plough, banked with turf and marked with fieldstones. No clergy lives near enough to speak over anyone, so the words are said by whoever knew the dead best. The oldest markers have lost their names to the weather and are kept clear anyway.

src/data/institutionDescVariants.js :: DESC_VARIANT_SIBLINGS::Carts go out at dusk to ground bought beyond the walls, and the charnel house holds what the old plots gave up. What a family endowed decides who is lifted and who is left.

src/data/institutionDescVariants.js :: DESC_VARIANT_SIBLINGS::The old grounds inside the walls filled generations ago, so the dead are lifted once their term is up and their bones stacked in the charnel house to make room for the next. New ground has been bought outside the gates, and the carts that go out at dusk are a fixed part of the city's evening. Who is lifted and who is left where they lie is settled by what a family endowed.
